workflows.workflowGoal: Determine what different demographic groups are interested in from their Reddit posts.
workflows.description: Use the Parallel Sets to establish a demographic group, reveal its modeled topics and ranked bigrams, and inspect matching posts when a term needs interpretation.
workflows.applicabilityContext: Applies to T1 when an analyst starts with one or more demographic dimensions and wants to understand the topics discussed by a group.
targetUsers: industry partners performing demographic analysis for marketing
academic professors studying online behavior of demographic groups

stages.localGoal: Choose and read the demographic dimensions and group combinations to examine.
stages.activitySummary: Choose the starting Parallel Sets dimension when needed, then read the sex, age, and education categories and ribbon widths.

usedCoordinations.description: The chosen starting dimension sets the first Parallel Sets dimension and its color assignment.

stages.expectedOutcome: A demographic ordering and group combination are established for interest exploration.

quotes: permits interactive selection of the starting dimension

stages.localGoal: Identify the topics and ranked terms that describe a demographic group's interests.
stages.activitySummary: Hover a demographic ribbon to highlight linked topic streams and word-cloud terms, or hover a topic to trace it back to interested groups.

usedCoordinations.description: A hovered demographic group highlights its topics.
A hovered topic highlights interested demographic groups.

stages.expectedOutcome: The analyst obtains a concise, interpretable topic summary for the group and can reverse-trace a topic to groups.

stages.localGoal: Interpret an unfamiliar or concerning topic term in the underlying user-generated content.
stages.activitySummary: Click a bigram and read the matching post list and selected post with its user, subreddit, timestamp, and votes.

usedCoordinations.description: A selected bigram opens its matching source posts.

stages.expectedOutcome: The selected bigram becomes understandable in authentic post context.

quotes: Seeing how a bigram is mentioned in the detailed posts helps users to understand certain keywords

transitions.rationale: After locating a group in the Parallel Sets, the interface is designed to connect it to corresponding topics through hover highlighting.
When a bigram is obscure, the paper explicitly directs users to click it to see detailed posts.

quotes: To help users better understand the topics, clicking on a bigram in a topic brings up a list of posts

workflows.expectedFinalOutcome: An interpretable account of a demographic group's topic interests grounded, when needed, in source posts.

workflows.workflowGoal: Determine which demographic groups have distinct interests and which share similar interests.
workflows.description: Inspect the user clusters formed from topic similarity and use coordinated highlighting to relate cluster composition to demographic groups and topics.
workflows.applicabilityContext: Applies to T2 when analysts need to compare topic-interest cohesion or overlap among demographic groups.
targetUsers: industry partners performing demographic analysis for marketing
academic professors studying online behavior of demographic groups

stages.localGoal: Find cohesive, separable, and mixed groups of users based on topic interests.
stages.activitySummary: Read t-SNE glyph clusters, decode their demographic variables with the legend, and hover glyphs to emphasize users in the same group.
stages.expectedOutcome: Candidate groups with cohesive, distinct, or overlapping interests are identified.

stages.stageTitle: Trace clusters to groups and topics
stages.localGoal: Identify the demographic groups and shared topics represented by an interesting cluster.
stages.activitySummary: Hover a group in the cluster view and read the corresponding highlighted group in Parallel Sets and topics; optionally trace a highlighted group or topic back into the cluster view.
stages.expectedOutcome: The analyst can explain a cluster in terms of demographic composition and the topics shared or separated by its users.

quotes: The cluster view is coordinated with other views.

transitions.rationale: After a cluster or demographic group is noticed, the explicitly coordinated hover interaction reveals its corresponding demographic group and topics.

workflows.expectedFinalOutcome: A comparison of which demographic groups have cohesive or overlapping interests, together with the topics that explain the pattern.

workflows.workflowGoal: Analyze how topical, linguistic, and peripheral features contribute to predicting demographic information.
workflows.description: Compare contribution and cumulative AUC values in the feature table, then expand linguistic features and inspect definitions for finer-grained interpretation.
workflows.applicabilityContext: Applies to T3 when demographic ground truth is scarce and an analyst wants to understand which features from posts and metadata support demographic classification.
targetUsers: industry partners performing demographic analysis for marketing
academic professors studying online behavior of demographic groups

stages.localGoal: Compare individual feature contribution and cumulative predictive accuracy across demographic variables.
stages.activitySummary: Read the upper contribution table and lower cumulative-AUC table across feature rows and demographic columns.
stages.expectedOutcome: The strongest individual features and effective cumulative feature combinations are identified for each demographic prediction.

stages.localGoal: Interpret the specific linguistic dimensions that contribute most strongly for demographic groups.
stages.activitySummary: Expand the linguistic feature row to see the five highest-ranked dimensions and hover cells for definitions.
stages.expectedOutcome: The analyst obtains interpretable, finer-grained linguistic explanations behind demographic predictions.

transitions.rationale: The interface supports expanding the linguistic feature after inspecting aggregate feature rankings to obtain detailed ranking information.

workflows.expectedFinalOutcome: An interpretable assessment of which feature families and linguistic dimensions are most useful for demographic prediction.

paperLevelClaims.claimText: The interface is intended to support sensemaking and comparison of demographic groups and identification of features useful for demographic prediction.
The system makes the connection between categorical demographic information and textual content directly explorable.
